name: error-counter-bridge
description: Sends VS Code's diagnostics (the Problems panel) to the local Screenshot & Error Logger tray app. Diagnostics only, never file contents; localhost only.

commands.title: Error Counter Bridge: Send Diagnostics Now

errorCounterBridge.enabled.description: Send diagnostics to the local Screenshot & Error Logger app.

errorCounterBridge.includeInformation.description: Include information-level diagnostics. Hints are never sent.

errorCounterBridge.discoveryFile.description: Override the bridge discovery file. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ScreenshotErrorLogger\vscode-bridge.json
